name: Rio2 Limited
summary: Rio2 Limited engages in the exploration, development, and mining of mineral properties in Canada, Peru, Bahamas, and Chile. The company explores for copper, gold, and silver deposits. Its principal project holds 100% interests in the Fenix Gold Project covering an area of approximately 16,050 hectares located in Chile. The company also holds 99.1% interest in the Condestable Mine located in Peru. Rio2 Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
